summary: This informational document captures the design rationale of the early draft that became RFC 8205, the BGPsec protocol specification. It lists the decisions made for and against each design choice along with the supporting discussion. It gives background on why BGPsec looks the way it does.

eli5.summary: When a team builds something, it helps to write down why they chose each part. This is that diary for the internet route-signing system.

questions: why was bgpsec designed this way
what design choices were made for bgpsec
